decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse sits close to the core yogurt range and has visible public recognition, so management keeps it even though there is no recent evidence on its results.
As the publicly featured flagship Abendbrotkäse central to the announced cheese direction, it carries strong commitment, and any weakness would be attributed to temporary market conditions.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established offer and cheap to continue, so there is little pressure to withdraw it despite the lack of recent visibility.
The multi-variant spicy cheese line represents sizable sunk investment and assortment commitment, which favors persisting, perhaps by trimming variants rather than dropping the line.

The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the new cheese offer, which argues for keeping it, although the earlier withdrawal of the washed-rind soft cheese shows this category is the most vulnerable.
